pātaṃ.p: in the morning in the early morning.

R:
pātaṃ：ပါတံ （နိ）
နံနက်၌။ နံနက်အခါ၌။ပါတော

[ S. prātar], in the morning; tomorrow morning; Abh 1152 (~o page); D III 88, 15 (yaṃ taṃ sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya āharanti ~o taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ); M I 448, 6 (mayaṃ hi bhante pubbe sāyaṃ c’ eva bhuñjāma ~o ca divā ca vikāle);
